label: Black Hound
identity: Medium lean scent HOUND, short fur, long muzzle, black nose, tiny dark eyes, TWO attached floppy ears, FOUR connected canine legs/paws, ONE low gently curved tail rooted to rump. Weathered chestnut leather collar with small dull brass buckle only at front/side; plain leather at back. No hanging tag/harness/armor/magic/weapons. Same anatomy and scale as approved Tan Hunting Hound: about0.65m shoulder height/1.05m nose-to-rump beside1.75m adult. Correct alternating diagonal footfalls, restrained ear/tail lag, low forward bite with jaw open/contact then recoil; legs stay grounded and naturally attached. Full back has no muzzle/front buckle. Down whole hound lies with head on forepaws, all legs/tail/ears joined. Dense CHARCOAL/BLACK coat, warm umber muzzle/lower legs and subdued grey edge highlights. Natural dark canine fur, not a wolf, no red eyes.

label: Violet Imp
identity: Small lean VIOLET fiend, muted lavender skin with plum shadows, TWO short swept-back IVORY horns, TWO pointed ears, narrow amber eyes with dark pupils/lids, TWO connected clawed arms, TWO digitigrade legs/feet, ONE low curled rooted tail ending in small spade. Plain ochre/charcoal waistwrap and dark rope, no front buckle copied to back. Same body scale/anatomy as approved Crimson Bound Imp, about0.8m to horns beside1.75m adult.
